acceptable_evidence: original preregistration/configuration/source bytes with authentic chronology
v0.7 or v0.7.1 package/repository snapshot containing exact contract
Git history/bundle containing exact pre-outcome contract
historical manifest/execution record plus exact recovered bytes
Git object identity and chronology plus SHA-256 verification

required_recovery_targets.inspection_rule: Before R1 closes, inspect only non-outcome metadata explicitly licensed by historical provenance. Do not open numerical response values.

ready_condition: All load-bearing frozen contract artifacts recovered and hash-verified with candidate_values_inspected=false; guard returns READY_FOR_FROZEN_EXTERNAL_ADMISSION.
